mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (patient_id, doctor_id, schedule_id, department_id, appointment_date, time_slot, serial_number, symptom_description, status, create_time) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{scheduleId}, #{departmentId}, #{appointmentDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{serialNumber}, #{symptomDescription}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM appointment WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.user_name AS patient_name, u.user_phone AS patient_phone, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, dep.name AS department_name, CASE a.time_slot WHEN 'morning' THEN '上午' WHEN 'afternoon' THEN '下午' WHEN 'evening' THEN '晚间' ELSE a.time_slot END AS time_slot_name FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN hospital_doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = a.department_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status IN (0, 1)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM appointment GROUP BY status
SELECT d.name as department, COUNT(*) as count FROM appointment a JOIN department d ON d.id = a.department_id GROUP BY a.department_id, d.name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM appointment WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT d.name as doctor, d.title, COUNT(*) as count FROM appointment a JOIN hospital_doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id GROUP BY a.doctor_id, d.name, d.title ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.appointment_date = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.appointment_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM appointment a WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND status IN (0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT a.*, u.user_name AS patient_name, u.user_phone AS patient_phone, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, dep.name AS department_name, CASE a.time_slot WHEN 'morning' THEN '上午' WHEN 'afternoon' THEN '下午' WHEN 'evening' THEN '晚间' ELSE a.time_slot END AS time_slot_name FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN hospital_doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = a.department_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
